newsitem.title: UK: Vietnam to close debt deal by September 14 - bankers.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam to close debt deal by September 14 - bankers.

text.p: Vietnam is expected to close its debt restructuring agreement for up to $1.0 billion of debt with the London Club of commercial bank creditors by September 14, bankers said on Thursday.

According to official documents obtained by Reuters, Bank of Tokyo Mitsubishi Ltd, which is the closing agent for the deal, and Vietnam, agreed to a closing date for the debt financing plan on or before September 14.

However, the documents which were addressed to the international financial community stated: "Every effort is being made to hold the closing of the 1996-97 financing plan in the latter part of August of this year."
Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi was unavailable to comment.
